                                      Resolution 2024-04
                        Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors

         RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT with conditions for modifications to the Alyeska Resort Area
                                 Master Plan and Development Master Plan

       WHEREAS, Case # 2024-0061 is slated for the Planning and Zoning Commission on June 3,
          2024; and

       WHEREAS, the architects and developer for the projects have attended Girdwood Land Use
         Committee (LUC) and Girdwood Board of Supervisors (GBOS) meetings in February 2024 and
       May 2024 to present modifications to the existing Alyeska Resort Area Master Plan and to
           present the Development Master Plans; and

       WHEREAS, the community has expressed support for the projects at “Alyeska Village” and
         “Moose Meadows” developments and appreciates that these development projects address
           several of the community’s concerns, including:
               Creation of Workforce Housing of a variety of types
               Creation of community resources, including Little Bears Playhouse new location, pool,
                and fitness facilities
               Creation of additional commercial retail space
               Expansion of hotel and resort capacity and improvement to resort’s ski school and other
                      facilities fundamental to Alyeska Resort operations

       WHEREAS, the community has recently sent forward replacement to the existing Girdwood
         Area Plan (1994); the Girdwood Comprehensive Plan has been under development since 2018,
          and was recently submitted as a modification to the Municipal Comprehensive Plan, with a
          Planning and Zoning Hearing expected in July 2024 and potential adoption by the Assembly in
           the Fall; and

       WHEREAS, after a long and robust community conversation, and based on extensive public
         comments, the proposed Girdwood Comprehensive Plan Land Use Map shows “Glacier Creek
           Village” as designated Open Space; and

       WHEREAS, further support of this change in land designation is demonstrated in the recently
          adopted Girdwood Trails Plan, the culmination of 5 years of community effort, which was
          adopted by the Anchorage Assembly in March, 2024; and

       WHEREAS, the community has not supported the proposed “Glacier Creek Village”, as
          demonstrated by the desire for the land designation change, and

       WHEREAS, the LUC, at their May 13th 2024 meeting, recommended that GBOS provide a
           Resolution of Support for the project as presented, with the exception of the Glacier Creek
           Village development by a vote of 22 in favor and 1 opposed with 8 abstaining; and

        THEREFORE, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors resolves support for the Alyeska Resort
         Development Master Plan;

       ALSO THEREFORE the Girdwood Board of Supervisors resolves support for modification of
           the Alyeska Resort Area Master Plan “Alyeska Village” and “Moose Meadows” developments,
           but does not support the “Glacier Creek Village” development on the future extension of Tract
         A.

           Resolution of Support is passed and approved by the Girdwood Board of Supervisors by a vote
           of 3 to 2 the May 23, 2024 Special Meeting.




           Jennifer Wingard
       GBOS Land Use Supervisor                        Attest
